title: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM · The table
venue: the motel · the lobby TV at 3 AM · recaps never run · Box 13
logline: A segment shot in a diner: the host at a booth, and behind her at a numbered table a man smoothing his lapels, the same man from a page in Box 5 Wood hasn't opened since 2003. He recognizes the diner from a drawing that wasn't his. The strip draws his recognizing and not what he recognizes.
